evidence: Docker build succeeded and the container run failed exactly at the CUDA handoff: `torch_version=2.3.1`, `cuda_is_available=False`, then `torch.zeros(1).cuda()` raised `RuntimeError: Found no NVIDIA driver on your system. Please check that you have an NVIDIA GPU and installed a driver from http://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx`.
steps: Build the repro image with `bash run_repro.sh`.
Run the resulting container without `--gpus` so it has no NVIDIA runtime access.
Observe the `RuntimeError` when the script moves a tensor to CUDA.
